headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW6
deck: Lawro backs the favourites in both ties, with test3 and 123 fancied to come through.
body: First column here, so no record to own. Once it was six World Cups. Now it's two ties in a draft league.

ties.line: test3 have Gonzalo of Fulham away at Ipswich, one of the leakiest going. Calafiori is home to Leeds too. That should be enough. Mind you, Ndiaye is away at Liverpool, so good luck there. test2 have Havertz and Rice against Leeds, but Rice is a slight doubt. And Isak is home to Manchester City, one of the meanest around. A big man having a bad night is a big man in trouble.

123 have B.Fernandes home to Spurs and Schade at Villa. Haaland is away at Liverpool, one of the meanest defences. That's the catch. test4 have Mbeumo and Raya, both at home to soft ones. But Foden is suspended. And Justin is away at one of the sharpest attacks going. Two men short is two men short.
